title: Gold Bar XL Lemon Lime Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: The Gold Bar XL Refill Kit in Lemon Lime combines the sweet sharpness of Lemon with the lighter zest of Lime in a citrus-forward flavour that's bold but never too tart. It's a clean, fruity option for fans of punchy flavours, lifted by the natural brightness of the citrus blend. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill reservoir, preloaded with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid for a satisfying MTL vape with smooth throat feel and balanced vapour. These refills are made to work exclusively with the Gold Bar XL Prefilled Pod Kit, a simple and reliable device with a 1200mAh battery and easy inhale-activated design. The pod contains a mesh coil to ensure consistent flavour and vapour output. Once the pod and refill are empty, just slot in a fresh refill from the growing Gold Bar XL range.
